text.description_html:
Laurey 39421, Midtown Cabinet Knob in Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash

The Matte Black Midtown Cabinet Knob with a Terra Cotta Wash not only has a unique style, it also has a unique finish. Well-suited to rustic and tuscan home decor designs, the Midtown Cabinet Knob in Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash is sure to represent your style. The Midtown Cabinet Knob has a 1-1/4 inch diameter with a 1 inch projection.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Midtown Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39421 Midtown Cabinet Knob Iron Black and Terra Cotta:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
